name: cavemio-file-share
title: File share
description: Drop files, watch them upload, and they fold into one share link with an expiry and an optional password.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Choose files is a real button that opens the file picker; dropping works anywhere on the block.
- Each row names its file and status; added files and the ready link are announced from a status region, and errors are text beside the file.
- Removing a file aborts its upload through the signal; nothing is sent twice.
- The flight is the rows themselves animated up before they fold away; nothing is cloned and focus stays put.
- Its light comes from your theme: the panel mixes --primary-foreground into --primary, file tiles take tints from --chart-1 to --chart-5. No drop shadows, glow or blur.
- Built from Segmented control, Switch, Input, Copy button, Number roll, Status button and Text morph, which the CLI installs with it. No animation library; with reduced motion nothing flies and the panel changes in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: onUpload
props.description: – · Upload one file; call onProgress(0–1), honour signal, resolve with what you need later (a key). Throw to offer Retry.

props.name: onCreateLink
props.description: – · files carry { name, size, type, result }; expiresIn is in days.

props.name: accept / maxSize / maxFiles
props.description: — / — / 20 · File types, bytes per file and how many files.

props.name: expiries
props.description: [1, 7, 30] · Days the link can live, as a segmented choice.

props.name: ref
props.description: – · { add(files) } to add files from a paste handler or your own button.

useCases.title: Send files
useCases.description: A WeTransfer-style page for clients to send or receive large files.

useCases.title: Deliverables
useCases.description: An agency or freelancer handing over a project’s files with an expiry.

useCases.title: Support uploads
useCases.description: Customers sharing logs or recordings with a password.

useCases.title: Internal drops
useCases.description: A quick way to share builds or exports inside a team.

features.title: Upload on drop
features.description: Each file starts as it’s added, with progress from onUpload’s callback and an abort signal for removal.

features.title: Failures you can retry
features.description: A failed upload keeps its row with the reason and a Retry; files over maxSize say so and never upload.

features.title: Totals as they go
features.description: The file count and the share sent roll while everything uploads.

features.title: Expiry and password
features.description: A segmented choice of days and a password switch that opens its field; both reach onCreateLink.

features.title: Files into a link
features.description: Create link sends the rows flying into the panel, which becomes the link card with Copy.

features.title: Add from anywhere
features.description: A ref with add(files) lets a paste handler or your own button add files.

states.title: empty
states.description: The lit panel with a thin line drop area: an upload glyph, “Drop files to share” and choose files.

states.title: drag
states.description: Files over the block brighten the area’s edge, settle it to 0.985× and morph the line to “Release to add 3”.

states.title: uploading
states.description: Rows with a type tile, name, size and a rolling percent over a thin line that fills; the header rolls “3 files · 55 MB” and the share sent.

states.title: retry
states.description: A failed upload shows the reason in red with a Retry button; removing a file aborts it.

states.title: options
states.description: Expires after 1, 7 or 30 days, and a Password switch whose field folds open; Create link waits for a password once it’s on.

states.title: link
states.description: Create link → Creating link → the rows arc up into the panel (560ms, 70ms apart) and the panel turns to the link: count and size, expiry, the URL with Copy, and the files fanned as tiles.
